Nora (CS): Heads-up: Orchid QBR Tue 9am PT. Need: token runway slide, two commit scenarios (conservative + aggressive), onboarding status, and a one-line renewal ask. Can @Ben - FinOps own econ?

Ben - FinOps: I can. Plan to show last 30d daily + 90d trend, per-route top 5, and a simple table comparing current vs quantized unit cost. Quick question: current commit on record is 40M/mo, right?

usage-bot: ALERT: orchid-llc crossed 68% of monthly commit yesterday. Link: https://billing.redwood.example/orchid-llc/usage

Izzy (SE): Onboarding update: prod ingest is live but we saw a retry burst during a bulk backfill that spiked tokens. Root cause = missing backpressure + duplicate producer messages. Hotfix validated in staging at 08:30. Prod deploy awaiting their infra maintenance window (ETA Mon 14:00 PT).

Kai (CSM): Customer asks to capture: 1) short justification for any commit increase, 2) temporary burst cushion, 3) clarity on whether quantized models will maintain exact JSON outputs.

Ben - FinOps: Draft quick numbers (pre-verify): last 30d tokens = 36,700,000; projected month = ~41.2M at current pace; estimated overage if unthrottled = ~1.2M tokens (~$260 at current unit rates). I'll run the commit sims (+10% and +30%) and produce a 1-line recommendation.

Ben - FinOps: Query I ran for per-route medians:
```sql
SELECT route, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY tokens) AS median_tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer_id='orchid-llc' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route;
```

Izzy (SE): I tested q2-small-quant on their prompts. Most routes preserved schema; one strict parser failed due to minor float formatting. Risk note: "templating review required" if we recommend quantization in the QBR. Latency delta estimate: +5-8ms median.

Kai (CSM): I'll pull a short customer quote to include in the slide. They said on the call: "We need predictability — bursts are killing our dev budget." I'll also draft the commit ask language for sales.

Nora (CS): Owners recap: Ben (charts, commit sims, alerts), Izzy (integration notes + risk), Kai (customer quote + commit ask + sales handoff), Nora (deck + runbook). Ben please create 80%/90% alerts and a proposed throttle schedule (soft throttle at 80%, stricter at 95%). Reconvene Mon 4:30pm PT for final pass. :thumbsup:
